verdict.rationale: x402 lets AI agents pay merchants per request with stablecoins. Agents can find payable services through the Bazaar MCP server and AgentCore, and the docs mention x402-enabling a Payment Acceptance merchant checkout so agents can authorize payment sessions. However, nothing shows buyers completing product purchases inside named assistant surfaces such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot; the documented use cases are mostly paying for API calls and resources. Missing for 10: documented integrations with specific chat/assistant surfaces, an in-chat product checkout flow for physical/catalog goods, card/fiat buyer payment in those surfaces, independent hands-on corroboration of in-assistant purchases.
